title: They are ok, but not hotel quality
text: They are ok, but not hotel quality. I bought those because my friend always told me about her egyptian cotton sheets and that nothing in the world is better than that. I went ahead at the last sale and got myself also a set, most likley not the same price class as hers, since the quality is not the same. Those are ok, but not as super soft and luxurious as I remember my friends bedding to be. I will have to ask her for the brand to get a different sent another time. Overall, I think if you don't expect super high quality, they are good, just not as good as I hoped.
